withdrawing flatmate one-to-one, keep the ask small, avoid a grand settling meeting — and this convergence is more trustworthy than any of the three diagnoses because it survives whichever diagnosis turns out to be correct.","scope":"This household.","grounds":"Each input reaches the same move from a different diagnosis: the account via its one-to-one step, the objection by promoting the conversational-form reading, the rival by demanding separate conversations.","mentions":["daily/mini_fcl/cycle-1/account#c3","daily/mini_fcl/cycle-1/objection#c1","daily/mini_fcl/cycle-1/rival#r6"]},{"id":"k2","type":"claim","text":"The account's fallback rule agreements under shifting work schedules.","grounds":"The objection's own illustration, where one flatmate cites the agreement and the other cites a changed shift, is directly addressed by a relational or load driver; pullback from a proposal's form supports the resistance-to-being-bound reading; non-engagement even one-to-one points to the conversation channel itself or to something outside the chores.","scope":"This household over the next few weeks.","depends":["daily/mini_fcl/cycle-1/objection#o2","daily/mini_fcl/cycle-1/rival#r7"],"revises":["daily/mini_fcl/cycle-1/account#c2"]},{"id":"k4","type":"claim","text":"Explicitness and interventions.","grounds":"The material gives no access to any flatmate's own account of any single elsewhere.","target":["daily/mini_fcl/cycle-1/rival#r6","daily/mini_fcl/cycle-1/rival#r2"],"bearing":"If the withdrawing flatmate is in fact waiting to be asked the household question directly, a null or confusing pattern should weaken confidence in the whole diagnostic layer rather than in one reading."},{"id":"u1","type":"use","text":"Run the revised probe: propose at most one or two concrete recurring items with a fallback rule, framed as provisional and unaudited, and over the following two weeks watch both channels — content-engagement versus form-pullback, and recurrence falling, persisting, or displacing to new complaint items.","action":"One item, recorded informally (message thread or fridge note) with a done-criterion, a timing, and a schedule-change fallback; do not convert one-to-one content into a group agenda item.","consequence":"Preserves the channel through which a divergent reading could first be voiced; breach converts a probe into surveillance.","depends":["u2","daily/mini_fcl/cycle-1/rival#r10"]},{"id":"p1","type":"problem","text":"The material still does not say what the recurring chores are, whether the load is unequal, why the withdrawing flatmate avoids the conversations, or whether the avoidance concerns the household at all;
